Description: Player enters the yard; camera swings to first person
Castle windows and doors light up red
Wave 1: fierce low-level demons pour from the door and windows
Wave 1 must be cleared by here
Music slows to an unrelenting pace
Hexagram portal opens; boss rises out of the ground with sword (player still fighting the last of wave 1)
Boss roars; player thrown into the fence
Music slows to an unrelenting pace
Boss must be dead by here
Wave 2 must be cleared by here
Music slows to an unrelenting pace
Wave 3: minions spawn but are scared and run away
Wave 3 must be cleared by here
Godlike demon emerges; instructs the player to keep purging corrupted souls
Player smashes the personal artifact and pledges fealty
